ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes and 25% low-intensity black pixels localized centrally and along leading/trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions covering lateral lobes; dark pigmentation at peduncle insertion radiating into mottled patterns near the central notch; small isolated dark focal spots on the white background of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45-55 degrees at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; increased amplitude and jaggedness visible on the outer lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge sweep transitioning to acute upward-hooked lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark circular pixel clusters visible against the white background, particularly on the inner half of the right lobe and center-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical dark linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the lower-center section of the right lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear rake marks on the right lobe; dense dark mottling/scarring surrounding the median notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward-curving lateral tips with high-density serration.
